name: soc-console
description: Localhost-only SOC console frontend (EPIC-10). Read-only over the experiment outputs plus one accept/reject write. The system recommends and never executes.

scripts.gen:types: uv run --project .. python -m thesis.api.export_openapi src/api/openapi.json && openapi-typescript src/api/openapi.json -o src/api/types.ts
scripts.build: npm run gen:types && tsc --noEmit && vite build
